visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of three large, golden-brown fried breads displayed behind a glass cabinet. One is topped with a thick layer of yellow pistachio cream, another with white cream and whole walnuts, and the third with rich chocolate and pecans. The indoor lighting highlights the textures of the toppings and the oily sheen of the bread. (2) A wide shot reveals a unique circular building crafted from textured, light-colored stone blocks. A minimalist black square logo featuring a stylized croissant and the text 'HAREYA' is positioned above the entrance. The scene is set against a vibrant green hillside and a deep blue, clear sky under bright natural daylight. (3) Inside the bakery, the camera pans across a modern interior characterized by dark wood counters and geometric ceiling designs. Various drinks in glass bottles are arranged on industrial-style metal shelves. In the background, two staff members in white uniforms are seen working behind a sleek black coffee machine. (4) A detailed montage of the bakery's offerings shows rows of flaky, buttery croissants with deep golden curves. Other trays contain round buns with cross-shaped markings and savory breads topped with bright green sliced scallions and a creamy orange roe topping. The objects are neatly arranged on clean black display trays. (5) The final sequence shows a contemporary glass-fronted building overlooking a scenic valley. A person's hand, with manicured nails, holds a plastic cup of iced latte. The cup features a circular blue logo with 'HAREYA' text. The background shifts between the scenic hillside and the stone architectural structure under consistent summer sunlight.

It leverages high-quality visuals of pastries and a modern stone building designed by Kengo Kuma to attract viewers interested in aesthetics, architecture, and culinary experiences. The soft Japanese BGM reinforces the high-end, relaxing lifestyle atmosphere described in the text.
